annotations.title: Package Vulnerabilities: Known CVEs for npm and PyPI Versions

description: Check an npm or PyPI package version against a public vulnerability database: advisory ids, aliases (CVE, GHSA), summary, severity label and first fixed version, plus the latest published version. Informational; not a full security audit. Read-only: returns data, nothing is changed or sent. Free over MCP (30 requests a minute).

name.description: Package name, e.g. lodash or requests.

version.description: Version to check. Default: latest published version.
